posts.title: The Benefits of AI, and the Traps We Miss
posts.description: I want AI to give me time back. That means looking past the impressive demo to the rework, habits and quieter compromises that come with everyday use.

posts.title: The Matrix Moment, and the Limits of Automation
posts.description: Agent fluency can make an implausible number of projects feel possible. The final skill is not learning to automate everything; it is deciding which possibilities deserve the cost, risk, and attention.

posts.title: What an AI-Native Organisation Looks Like
posts.description: An AI-native organisation is not a conventional team with more licences. Its processes, review capacity, incentives, and ownership model have to change when implementation is no longer the scarce resource.
